description: A strip marker removes tab characters
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The tab U+0009 has the White_Space property but is not a space separator (category Zs). Stripping it is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
